Faq.metaDescription: Find answers to common questions about creating custom Lotería cards. Learn how it works, pricing, printing, and more.

items.question: What is Lotería and how do you play it?
items.answer: Lotería is a traditional Mexican game of chance, similar to bingo. Players use boards (tablas) with a 4x4 grid of images. A caller (cantor) draws cards and announces them, and players mark matching images on their boards. The first to complete a pattern wins!

items.question: How do I create a custom Lotería set with my own photos?
items.answer: Upload your photos and we restyle each one into a traditional Lotería-style illustration with a Spanish label. You then arrange your cards, edit labels, and generate printable tablas (boards) so you have a complete Lotería set ready to play.

items.question: Can I use this for my wedding or party?
items.answer: Absolutely! A custom Lotería set is perfect for weddings, quinceañeras, birthday parties, family reunions, and any special celebration. Personalize the cards with your guests, memorable moments, or themed photos — and print tablas for everyone at the party.

items.question: How many cards can I create?
items.answer: With the free preview, you can create up to 4 cards and generate one sample board. By unlocking your board for {price}, you get access to 54 cards (a full traditional Lotería deck) and unlimited board generations.

items.question: What file formats can I export?
items.answer: You can export your Lotería boards as high-quality printable PDFs, perfect for home or professional printing. Individual cards can also be downloaded as images.

items.question: Is there a subscription or recurring fee?
items.answer: No subscriptions! Our pricing is simple — try for free, and when you're ready, pay a one-time {price} fee to unlock your board. That purchase gives you permanent access to that project.
